commit.message:
fix(admin-video): per-fetch try/catch + KV-cache nostr fallback (#140)

* fix: KV-cache the Nostr imeta-url fallback in /admin/video proxy

The fallback added in #138 opened a fresh WebSocket to relay.divine.video
on every miss. With a 50-card dashboard render hitting the proxy in
parallel, that meant up to 50 concurrent WS connections per page load —
exhausting per-isolate budgets and surfacing as 500/502 in the moderator
console.

Cache the relay lookup result in MODERATION_KV with a 5-min TTL. Sentinel
empty string represents "no event found" so negative results are also
cached. Write goes through ctx.waitUntil so the request itself doesn't
wait on KV.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: GCS direct fallback for /admin/video proxy

Add a layer between the stored-content_url candidate and the relay
imeta-url fallback that hits GCS bucket divine-blossom-media directly
at the same sha path. The Blossom CDN sits in front of this bucket and
the bucket is publicly readable, so when the CDN returns 404 (moderation
enforcement, VCL gates, etc.) the underlying bytes are still reachable
without auth or relay roundtrip.

Bucket name configurable via env.GCS_BUCKET, defaulting to
divine-blossom-media (the production bucket per
divine-blossom/README.md).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
fix: dashboard speedup followups (4 must-fix + 3 should-fix from PR #136 review) (#137)

* fix: PR #136 review followups (4 must-fix + 3 should-fix)

PR #136 merged before the must-fix commit landed; this branch carries
the carry-overs and adds the should-fix items the reviewer flagged.

Must-fix:

1. latestBunnyEventBySha status_name filter timing (correctness bug).
   Filtering status_name INSIDE the CTE before ROW_NUMBER() silently
   resurrects deleted shas: a sha with finished@100 and deleted@200
   has the deleted row dropped from the CTE, making finished@100 the
   "latest" — but the old correlated subquery (MAX over all rows then
   require winner not be deleted) excluded it. Move the filter to
   AFTER ranking, on rn=1. Same fix in countLatestBunnyEvents. New
   regression test pins the correct semantic.

2. enrichAdminLookupVideo guard for client/content (detail-view bug).
   After PR #136 widened the SELECT, enriched.nostrContext is truthy
   on stored rows — but its `client` and `content` fields are
   hardcoded null because moderation_results doesn't store them. The
   single-video detail view (/admin/api/video/:id) was therefore
   silently dropping those fields from card UI. Widen the guard to
   trigger funnelcake when the stored nostrContext lacks both. List
   endpoints don't go through this helper any more, so the fetch
   only fires per detail-view click — by design.

3. Refresh button now bypasses the stats cache. dashboard.html
   previously called loadVideos() which left stats served from the
   60s KV cache. Add refreshDashboard() that calls loadRealStats(true)
   and loadAIDetectionStats(true), both of which pass ?fresh=1 to
   skip the cache read while still writing back.

4. /api/v1/decisions reverts to its original public-API column set.
   PR #136 inadvertently widened it via ADMIN_VIDEO_COLUMNS, leaking
   event_id/title/author/content_url/published_at to downstream
   consumers (e.g. divine-relay-manager) that may not tolerate
   unexpected fields. Comment now flags the contract pin.

Should-fix:

5. Backfill mutex TOCTOU honesty. KV doesn't expose CAS; read-then-
   write is racy under exactly-simultaneous calls. Document that the
   mutex is best-effort and the worst case is a duplicate funnelcake
   batch (UPDATE WHERE event_id IS NULL keeps DB writes idempotent).

6. Migration 009 ALTER TABLE non-idempotent comment. SQLite/D1 lacks
   ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS. Wrangler's migration tracker prevents
   reruns under normal deploys; document the manual-replay caveat
   for future operators.

7. cachedStat: never let a cache-write failure mask a successful
   compute. KV.put().catch() logs and moves on; the freshly computed
   value still returns. Production path (ctx.waitUntil) and fallback
   path (await) both safe.

Tests:
- New regression test in bunny-events.test.mjs (finished→deleted).
- New test in lookup-helpers.test.mjs (event_id but no title/author).
- 164 tests passing across 5 changed files.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ci): drop accidental backfill-relay-decisions import/handler

The previous commit on this branch unintentionally bundled an import
and handler for runRelayDecisionBackfill — code from a separate
parallel feature whose .mjs file isn't on this branch. CI's vite
import-analysis correctly flagged it as a missing module. This
commit removes both the import (line 38) and the
/admin/api/backfill/decisions handler that referenced it.

The dashboard-speedup followups themselves are unaffected — this is
only a cleanup of the misrouted bundling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
fix: stop preloading every video on the moderation dashboard (#139)

The dashboard renders 50 cards per page, each with a <video> element. Two
of them used preload="metadata" / preload="auto", which made the browser
fire 50 parallel range requests against /admin/video/{sha}.mp4 the moment
the page rendered. With the new Nostr-relay imeta-url fallback, every miss
also costs a relay round-trip — multiplying the load.

Switch both to preload="none". The existing onmouseenter="this.play()"
triggers the actual fetch on demand, so playback UX is unchanged but the
initial load drops 50 video fetches to zero.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
fix: fall back to Nostr imeta URL when admin video proxy can't serve from CDN (#138)

The /admin/video/{sha}.mp4 proxy returns 404/500/502 for many videos because
content_url is stored as the divine CDN URL (media.divine.video/{sha}) — the
exact URL the proxy already tried and got 404 from. The dedup at line 2782
correctly skips that candidate, leaving zero working sources.

Two-part fix:
1. Last-resort fallback in the proxy: fetch the Nostr event from
   relay.divine.video and try its imeta url before giving up. This unblocks
   moderators viewing external Blossom-hosted videos right now.
2. Source fix: stop writing cdnUrl as content_url when nostrContext.url is
   missing — leaving null lets the fallback run instead of poisoning the
   stored candidate.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
